# `is_variant_null`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Check if a variant value is a variant null. Returns true if and only if the input is a variant null and false otherwise (including in the case of SQL NULL).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
is_variant_null(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 1
> SELECT is_variant_null(parse_json('null'));
true
```

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 2
> SELECT is_variant_null(parse_json('"null"'));
false
```

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 3
> SELECT is_variant_null(parse_json('13'));
false
```

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 4
> SELECT is_variant_null(parse_json(null));
false
```

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 5
> SELECT is_variant_null(variant_get(parse_json('{"a":null, "b":"spark"}'), "$.c"));
false
```

```sql
-- is_variant_null, example 6
> SELECT is_variant_null(variant_get(parse_json('{"a":null, "b":"spark"}'), "$.a"));
true
```
